verdict.rationale: cubic reviews new PRs automatically by default and documents on-demand triggering by commenting `@cubic-dev-ai review this PR` or tagging the bot in PR comments. Ultrareview can also be requested for extra scrutiny. cubic.yaml controls "AI review behavior" and "ignore patterns", but nothing shows it can skip drafts or gate reviews by branch or label. Missing for 10: documented draft-PR skipping, branch-based review filters, label-based review triggers/filters, any way to turn off auto-review in favor of on-demand only, and independent corroboration.
